text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Tsuyoshi-senpai!
Even though it's heavy luggage, for you to carry it for me...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's no trouble at all!
I can't just ignore a junior in need!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"There's still luggage left, right?!
Leave all of that to me too!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *wheeze*...!
I'm only halfway there... I can't... collapse yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi ended up overdoing it.
Not only was she unable to help to the very end,
but she also caused her junior to worry...
